name: shutter-governance-protocol-frontend
description: Admin + Voter browser apps and a shared multi-election dashboard for shutter-governance-protocol.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @shutter-governance-protocol/admin && npm run build -w @shutter-governance-protocol/voter
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/admin/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/voter/tsconfig.json --noEmit
